ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 70-75% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated primarily at the leading edges, central notch region, and trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black pigmentation is mapped as dense, contiguous mottling along the proximal center and leading edges. The right lobe features discrete, elongated black pixel streaks and small circular punctate markings. The left lobe exhibits more diffuse, speckled black clusters toward the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes. The right lobe trailing edge displays three prominent, deep macro-notches (concave pixel voids), while the left lobe shows a more consistent, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex sweep transitioning to a slight dorsal-posterior curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, beige/white textured circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, a series of 3-4 parallel dark streaks are mapped on the medial-lateral section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scalloping and missing tissue segments (notches) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; presence of established barnacle colonies on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive, isolated dark circular pigmentation cluster located in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe white field.
